_doc: Minimal schema for config/coach_settings.json. Read by coach_integration.py and coaches/__init__.py at runtime.

_notes.model: Must be a valid Anthropic model string. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 is the default for low-latency live coaching.
_notes.tft_pbe: When true, coaches/__init__.py routes TFT sessions to tft_pbe_coach.py (Set 17 data). Defaults to false if absent.
